rows.For VoiceMail / Text: Always check the history if unsure
If naay concern ang customer, please raised sa whatsapp
if naay mga credit notes / new customer nga wanted to order ( with name & address ni sya nga format) screenshot and send sa whatsapp
If naay gi raised sa whatsapp and dugay mo reply cla, pls skip the product and proceed sa lain. create another order if accepted na
For Quantities : If ni mentioned lang cya ug each or heads, din sa system kay naka kg or box -- please qg note sa heads and only used 1kg for quantity especially sa mga fish orders.
Much better if mo sayu kag process sa prep, para ig tongtong for example 8:59 igo nalang mag refresh if nay mga prep para maka send dayun
Please check the date after midnight kay basin ma order na sya sa lain adlaw
For ELY (address) customers, dghan na cla so please make sure ma book sya sa correct customer
For Rosey Lea customer, naa ni sya 3 ka venue, Make sure to book this to the correct customer since IFISH ni sya
IF Tilbury mentioned to invoice the item to whitehart, create new order for white hart and book the product then put in the additional notes "deliver to tilbury"
if naay mga customer na inactive, please ask supplier for confirmation if e process cya or not
